text: Joomi amen, menen men nanii noddoowo on woni Annabiijo Maa on Muhammadu (yo o his), no nodda e gomɗingol o wi'a: "Gomɗinee Alla Joomi mo'on Bajjo", men gomɗini kon ko o noddi e mun, men jokki laawol makko ngol, Haforan men junuubi amen Surraa men, Yawtanaa men boneeji amen hara A Nanngiraali men ɗin, Ƴeeŋinndinaa men e moƴƴuɓe ɓen, Hawrinndinaa men e golle moƴƴe e accude golle bonɗe.
